desc: Date.now() is in milliseconds but ttl is in seconds: entries expire 1000x too early (after 60 ms, not 60 s)
get() never moves the entry to the back of the Map, so eviction drops the oldest inserted entry, not the least recently used: it is FIFO
writeFile is not awaited: save() resolves before the data is written and a write error becomes an unhandled rejection
JSON.parse keeps a "__proto__" key and for...in visits it, so {"__proto__": {"admin": true}} merges into Object.prototype
sort() without a comparator orders numbers as strings: [500, 50000, 1000000] sorts as [1000000, 500, 50000], so pickTier(tiers, 400) returns 1000000 instead of 500
